isolation.boundary: public discovery route only; deterministic empty-state fixture query; no shared data changes

assertions.title: Discovery empty states are explicit and calm

steps.action: Open /restaurants?fixture=empty-state on the public discovery surface
steps.expected: A deterministic empty discovery state renders without leaving the guest shell
steps.observed: The restaurants page loaded on the fixture URL and stayed inside the guest discovery shell.

steps.action: Inspect the page content and visual state
steps.expected: Guests see clear empty-state guidance and next steps instead of a blank or broken layout
steps.observed: The page showed the calm empty-state message “No tables are open to book just yet” with follow-up actions for home, full list, and bookings.

steps.action: Check browser errors and request log after the empty state rendered
steps.expected: No console/page errors block the empty state
steps.observed: agent-browser errors returned no page errors; the network request log did not capture entries beyond the already-loaded document.

evidence.network: document GET /restaurants?fixture=empty-state -> 200 page load; agent-browser request log reported no additional captured requests

summary: Tested 1 assertion on the public discovery surface: VAL-DISCOVERY-005 passed via the deterministic empty-state fixture and showed explicit calm guest guidance.
